footnote_text: On November 19, 2026, pursuant to an arrangement agreement dated as of July 21, 2026, Brookfield Infrastructure Partners Inc. ("BIP Inc."), Brookfield Infrastructure Partners L.P. ("BIP LP") and Brookfield Infrastructure Corporation ("BIPC") completed a court approved plan of arrangement under section 288 of the Business Corporations Act (British Columbia) (the "Arrangement"), pursuant to which, among other things, holders of non-voting limited partnership units of BIP LP (the "BIP Units") and holders of class A exchangeable subordinate voting shares of Brookfield Infrastructure Corporation (the "BIPC Exchangeable Shares") received class A subordinate voting shares of BIP Inc. in exchange for their BIP Units and BIPC Exchangeable Shares on a one-for-one basis. This Form 4 represents BIP Units and BIPC Exchangeable Shares transacted pursuant to the Arrangement.
